children: WASHINGTON (dpa-AFX) - McKesson Corp. (MCK) announced earnings for its second quarter that Increases, from last year
The company's bottom line totaled $1.218 billion, or $10.47 per share.  This compares with $1.110 billion, or $8.95 per share, last year.
Excluding items, McKesson Corp. reported adjusted earnings of $1.363 billion or $11.68 per share for the period.
The company's revenue for the period rose 7.6% to $110.957 billion from $103.150 billion last year.
